newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Notionnel to break 128.40, head lower.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Notionnel to break 128.40, head lower.

text.p: MATIF September notionnel futures will continue to correct lower on Tuesday, finding support just above 128.00, analysts said.
Fran Skelley, head of technical analysis at Credit Suisse First Boston in London, said the contract would slide to around 128.20.
"I think we'll break 128.40 today and then it will come off towards 128.00, but I don't think we'll go to 128.00," Skelley said.
By 0740 GMT, September notionnel were 0.06 down on the day at 128.60.

After 128.40, which is the bottom of a small gap earlier this month, notionnel would also slide through 128.32, a 38.2 percent retracement of the rally from 126.40 on June 2 up to the high of 129.52 on June 16, Skelley said.
Upside moves would be limited to 129.06, the high on Thursday, with trendline resistance at 128.80 on hourly charts.
Elizabeth Miller at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said a break of 128.40 would be significant. "If we break it it will confirm that it's going to move downwards this week," she said.
Miller saw further support 128.05 and 127.96, a 50 percent retracement of the June rally, then at 127.30.
Miller said a large head-and-shoulders was dominating the weekly notionnel continuation chart with the head being at around 133.00 in mid-February. That formation would be negated if 130.90 gave way.
Before that, Monday's high of 128.82 would be the first barrier, providing a short-term bounce to 129.06, and even 129.30.
On the downside, Miller was watching for 127.90 to fall.
September Pibor futures were quoted 0.01 lower on the day at 96.53.
